about: Renders a row of menus along the top of an application: one tab stop, the arrow keys moving along the bar, and at most one menu open. A mouse moving onto another name while a menu is open opens that menu instead, and the arrows at a panel's side open the menu beside it.

controlled.about: The caller keeps `value` and changes it in `onValueChange`, and the status line reads the open menu.
controlled.title: Controlled

editor.about: An editor's menus with commands and their keys, a separator and a submenu. Press a name, or move to the bar with Tab and open a menu with ArrowDown, Enter or Space. ArrowRight and ArrowLeft in a panel open the menu beside it.
editor.title: Editor

folded.about: The bar measures its row. While its names do not fit, the bar folds into one Menu trigger, and each menu of the bar becomes a submenu of it, so every menu is reachable.
folded.title: Folded

icons.about: Rows lead with an icon, and `inset` on the Message menu starts the words of a row without one after the icon's gutter. A critical row reads the error palette and names what it destroys.
icons.title: Icons and a critical row

label: Editor

options.about: Checkbox rows keep the menu open while they turn, and a radio row closes it once chosen. The name of the Panel menu reads the chosen panel.
options.title: Options

palette.about: The eight palettes. Move the pointer onto a name or open a menu: the names and the rows of the menus fill in the palette the root sets.
palette.title: Palettes

rtl.about: With `dir="rtl"`, the bar runs from the right, the arrows swap, and a submenu opens to the left: the arrow pointing at the next name moves to it.
rtl.label: المحرر
rtl.title: Right to left

size.about: Every size. The size sets the names' padding and text, and the menus' rows.
size.title: Sizes

stop.about: Tab reaches the bar once and leaves it once, however many menus the bar contains. The arrows move between the names.
stop.title: One tab stop

title: Menubar
